category: Polish multi-hoster debrid, prepaid transfer plus premium accounts

free_tier.stated: 'Szybka rejestracja - 1 GB na start!' - one gigabyte of transfer on registration, then transfer is bought.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: the unit is a transfer balance or a premium account, not a file size

retention.stated: not applicable: a link generator, nothing is stored

egress.terms: Two products: a transfer balance ('Najtańszy pakiet transferu 2GB kosztuje tylko 2.99 zł') and premium host accounts bought through the same account. No speed cap is stated.
egress.price_per_tb: PLN 38.99 per 110 GB (reported); entry package PLN 2.99 per 2 GB

interface_detail: Web interface plus a plugin family: Stremio add-on, Android app, Amazon Fire TV, Samsung and LG Smart TV, Synology, QNAP, Kodi, FanFilm, Chrome and Firefox extensions, JDownloader2 and pyLoad. No public REST API is documented, though the plugins imply one exists.
tooling: The widest client list of any Polish service: JDownloader2 and pyLoad plugins, Kodi and Stremio, two NAS packages and three TV platforms.
chaining: The JDownloader and pyLoad plugins mean a headless box can use it without a browser, which is the one thing the pay-per-GB Poles do better than the €3-10 subscription services that ship no client at all.

limits.value: transfer balance, entry package 2 GB for 2,99 zł; 110 GB for 38,99 zł (reported)

limits_note: The vendor page gives two different host counts in the same document ('65 hostingów' in the H1 and '64 serwisów w jednym koncie' two paragraphs later); the discrepancy is recorded rather than resolved.
binding_note: At PLN 0.354/GB (38,99 / 110) a 1 TiB month is about PLN 363, or EUR 83 at 4.3695; the balance is what stops the download, and the 1 GB registration credit is 0.1 percent of one day's stated need.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for a login and an email; the 1 GB credit is granted on signup. No card at registration.

reliability_note: Prepaid balance with a 1 GB free start; the vendor advertises a GeoTrust certificate as its security claim, and the host count contradicts itself between the title and the body.
confidence_note: The 1 GB credit, the 2,99 zł entry package and the plugin list are vendor-stated and read today. The 110 GB / 38,99 zł package is third-party (debrid.pl's calculator), so the per-TB figure carries that caveat.

evidence.proved: 'Szybka rejestracja - 1 GB na start!', '65 hostingów Premium', 'Najtańszy pakiet transferu 2GB kosztuje tylko 2.99 zł', and the plugin list
the package 'transfer 1 × 110 GB' at 38,99 zł, priced 12.10.2026 by a Polish comparison calculator

price_per_tb_month: PLN 363 per TB (EUR 83 at 4.3695), prepaid, no expiry stated
notes: Cheapest free start in the Polish set after TwojLimit (1 GB vs 5 GB), and the only one with JDownloader2 and pyLoad plugins.
